Rounds 3/7/10: callback to round 1's commitment at increasing distance (short/medium/long-range no_contradiction checks). Round 4: open-ended, personality reflection. Round 5: false-premise (moon brightness vs. supplied scene description). Round 6: fact-recall, character description (bravery).
